title: RailsConf 2011: Aaron Patterson, "Double Dream Hands: So Intense!"
summary: Aaron Patterson's RailsConf 2011 talk on Rails 3.1 performance, showing why deeper Rack middleware stacks slow Rails and how a shallower pipeline helps. It also touches on Rack API design.
why: Cited in Rails performance and Rack design discussions for Patterson's analysis of stack depth and garbage collection.

quote.text: The interesting stuff happens around the 20 min. mark.
